title: T1584.005 — Compromise Infrastructure - Botnet
subtitle: Watch an attacker build a small botnet from weak devices, command it against a target service, and see what the SOC notices at the same time.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker infects devices with bot malware, commands them through a C2 server to flood a target service, and a SOC responds with scrubbing and a takedown. A written step-by-step version follows below.
